title: On-Demand Store Auditor
description_html:
Flexible in-store audit work near Nashua, NH 03060. Paid per audit, fast onboarding, go when it suits you.

Nashua audits are in the 03060 area, at grocery and retail stores close to home.

Hetal pays independent contractors to complete short audits at stores near you, like Walmart, Target, Kroger, Whole Foods and Sprouts. The app shows you which store and which aisles to check. You visit, complete the audit in the app, and get paid.

Why people like it

  • No interview and no set schedule. Pick audits that fit your week.
  • Setup takes about 2 minutes
  • Your first $10 audit is available as soon as you choose a location
  • Stores you already shop at, near home
  • No purchases, no customer interaction, no experience needed

Pay

  • $6 to $17 per audit, depending on size
  • Paid by direct deposit, typically within a week of completing an audit

How it works

  • New audits release every Monday and are due by Sunday night
  • You start with up to 3 audits per week. Complete them reliably and that number grows.

Good to know

  • This is independent contractor gig work, not employment. No hiring process. Download the app to get started.
  • No benefits and no mileage reimbursement. Per-audit pay is your full compensation.
  • You need a smartphone.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply.
